summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ongoing share buyback program. Between June 15-19, 2026, it repurchased ~1.97 million shares at GBP 9.8860-10.2000 per share from JP Morgan Securities plc on the London Stock Exchange. The buyback was authorized at the 2025 AGM under a January 6, 2026 arrangement. Shares will be cancelled, reducing the total issued to ~2.513 billion. Since program inception, 40.95 million shares were repurchased at an average of 1,102.5252p. This is an issuer tender via on-market purchases, with shares cancelled to enhance shareholder value. Watch for continued execution pace and impact on EPS.
